Name: Help Wanted
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod enhances the Help Wanted board in front of the Seed Shop.

Its main functionality is to replace the single "quest of the day" with a list of quest notes stuck to the billboard.

Other features include:

[list]
[*]Require people to actually like (or even love) the items they request (optional)
[*]Ignore the game's restrictions on items to request (only one of the above is set)
[*]Set a max price for item requests (default [b]-1[/b] means disabled)
[*]Toggle allowing requests for artisan goods (default [b]true[/b])
[*]Toggle avoiding posting quests from NPCs with max hearts (default [b]true[/b]) - only activates in single player mode
[*]Set a custom number of days allowed to complete help wanted quests (default [b]2[/b])
[*]Set the max number of quests per day (default [b]10[/b])
[*]Change the relative chance of receiving any type of quest
[*]Customize the default quest notes
[*]Add quests via a SMAPI API
[/list]
Relative quest type chances are relative to each other. Slay monster quests are only available if one has unlocked the mine and played for at least 6 days.

Max number of quests per day is limited by the number of notes that can fit on the board within the configurable overlap parameters.

[b][size=5]Custom Quest Notes[/size][/b]

To replace the default notepad icon and / or pin (drawn by Lumisteria) target the following paths using Content Patcher:

[b]aedenthorn.HelpWanted/pad[/b]
[b]aedenthorn.HelpWanted/pin

[/b]An example of a mod that does this is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14953](CP) Help Wanted Pad and Pin Retexture[/url]﻿.
[b]

[size=4]Specific Quest Notes[/size]

[/b]You can also make icons specific to npcs, quest types, or even quest types per NPC by targeting subpaths as follows:

[b]aedenthorn.HelpWanted/pad/NPCNAME[/b]
[b][b]aedenthorn.HelpWanted/pad/QUESTTYPE[/b]
[b][b]aedenthorn.HelpWanted/pad/NPCNAME[b][b]/QUESTTYPE[/b][/b][/b]
[/b]
[b]aedenthorn.HelpWanted/pin/NPCNAME[/b]
[b][b]aedenthorn.HelpWanted/p[b][b]in[/b][/b]/QUESTTYPE[/b]
[b][b]aedenthorn.HelpWanted/p[b][b]in[/b][/b]/NPCNAME[b][b]/QUESTTYPE[/b][/b][/b]
[/b][/b]
[/b]Replace NPCNAME with the codename of the NPC, e.g.

[b]aedenthorn.HelpWanted/pad/Emily

[/b]Replace QUESTTYPE with the quest type, e.g.[b]

[b]aedenthorn.HelpWanted/pad/ItemDelivery
[/b]
[/b]Valid quest types are:

[list]
[*][b]ItemDelivery[/b]
[*][b]ResourceCollection[/b]
[*][b]Fishing[/b]
[*][b]SlayMonster[/b]
[/list]

[b][size=4]Random Quest Notes[/size][/b][b]

[/b]Any of the above paths can be used to provide multiple textures to be chosen at random, by adding a suffix [b]/NUMBER[/b], e.g.:

[b]aedenthorn.HelpWanted/pad/1[/b]
[b][b]aedenthorn.HelpWanted/pad/2[/b]
...[/b]

[b]aedenthorn.HelpWanted/pin/Emily/ItemDelivery/1[/b]
[b][b]aedenthorn.HelpWanted/pin/Emily/[b]ItemDelivery[/b]/2
[/b]...

[/b]etc.

Numbers must be sequential, starting at 1.
[b]

[/b][b][size=5]Adding Quests[/size][/b][b][size=5]
[/size][/b]
Quests can be added using either Content Patcher or C#


[size=4][b]Content Patcher[/b][/size]

To add quests using Content Patcher, you can simply input the quest details as follows:

[code]﻿ {
"Action": "EditData",
"Target": "aedenthorn.HelpWanted/dictionary",
"Entries": {
"aedenthorn.TestQuest": {
﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿"percentChance": 100,
"quest": {
"questType": "ItemDelivery",
"target": "Krobus",
"item": "Gold Bar",
﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿"number": 1,
"questDescription": "Gib Gold Bar, Krobus",
"targetMessage": "Tanks bigly.",
"currentObjective": "Give Gold Bar to Krobus."
}
}
}
},
[/code]
If [b]percentChance[/b] is omitted (or set to 100), the quest will show up every day. You can use Content Patcher [b]When[/b] conditions to further choose when the quest will be added to the dictionary.

[b]questType [/b]can be any of the following:

[list]
[*][b]ItemDelivery[/b]
[*][b]ResourceCollection[/b]
[*][b]Fishing[/b]
[*][b]SlayMonster[/b]
[/list]
You can add [b]questTitle[/b] to give your quest a custom title.

You can customize the quest board visuals using the complete set of fields, which you can see [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods/blob/master/HelpWanted/JsonQuestData.cs]on GitHub[/url].


[size=4][b]SMAPI C#[/b][/size]

To add a quest with C#, use SMAPI's mod api system. You will need to create a class that implements the following interface:

[code]    public interface IQuestData
    {
        public Texture2D padTexture { get; set; }
        public Rectangle padTextureSource { get; set; }
        public Color padColor { get; set; }
        public Texture2D pinTexture { get; set; }
        public Rectangle pinTextureSource { get; set; }
        public Color pinColor { get; set; }
        public Texture2D icon { get; set; }
        public Rectangle iconSource { get; set; }
        public Color iconColor { get; set; }
        public float iconScale { get; set; }
        public Point iconOffset { get; set; }
        public Quest quest { get; set; }
    }
[/code]
You then pass an instance of this class to the API using another interface:

[code]﻿    public interface IHelpWantedAPI
    {
        public void AddQuestToday(IQuestData data);
    }
[/code]
This should be done in Helper.Events.GameLoop.DayStarted.

Here's an example:

[code]﻿        public override void Entry(IModHelper helper)
        {
            Helper.Events.GameLoop.DayStarted += GameLoop_DayStarted;
        }
        private void GameLoop_DayStarted(object sender, StardewModdingAPI.Events.DayStartedEventArgs e)
        {
            var api = Helper.ModRegistry.GetApi<IHelpWantedAPI>("aedenthorn.HelpWanted");
            if (api != null)
            {
                var d = new MyQuestData()
                {
                    pinTextureSource = new Rectangle(0, 0, 64, 64),
                    padTextureSource = new Rectangle(0, 0, 64, 64),
                    pinTexture = pinTexture,
                    padTexture = padTexture,
                    pinColor = Color.Black,
                    padColor = Color.Gray,
                    icon = Game1.getCharacterFromName("Krobus").Portrait,
                    iconSource = new Rectangle(0, 0, 64, 64),
                    iconColor = new Color(150, 150, 150, 150),
                    iconScale = 1,
                    iconOffset = new Point(32, 64),
                    quest = new ItemDeliveryQuest()
                };
                (d.quest as ItemDeliveryQuest).target.Value = "Krobus";
                (d.quest as ItemDeliveryQuest).item.Value = 305;
                (d.quest as ItemDeliveryQuest).targetMessage = "I can haz void egg? Tanks lots.";
                d.quest.currentObjective = "Gib Krobus void egg.";
                d.quest.questDescription = "Pls gib.";
                api.AddQuestToday(d);
            }
        }

[/code]

[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
